name: Sabah Sompoton Display
description: Original static interpretation of the Kadazan-Dusun sompoton from Sabah, Malaysia, with two tied groups of four bamboo tubes, a hollow dried-gourd wind chamber, and a separate stand. No sound or pitch simulation.
summary: Static Sabah sompoton with genuinely open bamboo bores, tied rafts and a hollow gourd.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Independently authored watertight shell with real neck and rafts socket, eight modeled bamboo tips assigned to frame length groups, vertex colour with no images, separate hand-shaped padded stand and Cycles studio preview.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Original non-playing exhibit inspired by documented fixture type, not a named cultural object or maker replica. Long-tip finish is illustrative, with no tuning, pitch or operating claim. Blender -Y front/+Z up, glTF +Z front/+Y up.

attribution.credit: Original mesh geometry, grain colors, text, stand and studio render.
